item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the dominance of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine and remain hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will affect the central to southern parts of the South China Sea over the weekend to early next week. It may develop into a tropical cyclone, but there are uncertainties in its development and movement. Showers associated with the area of low pressure is expected to affect the coastal areas of southern China early next week.
